OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the
            '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:

        - address
        - city
        - telephone

I implemented the household-duplicate rejection rule for `POST /api/owners`, following the existing duplicate-telephone pattern in the codebase.

**Changes:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added a `sharesHousehold` boolean property (write-only, default `false`) to the `OwnerFields` schema so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` carries the opt-in flag.

2. **`DuplicateOwnerHouseholdException.java`** (new) — A `RuntimeException` carrying the offending `lastName` and `address`, mirroring `DuplicateOwnerTelephoneException`.

3. **`ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`** — Added an `@ExceptionHandler` that maps the new exception to a **409 Conflict** whose `errors` array names `lastName` and `address`.

4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — Added `rejectDuplicateHousehold(...)` into the `addOwner` pipeline. It:
   - Skips the check when `sharesHousehold` is `true`.
   - Compares the incoming `lastName` **and** `address` against every existing owner using `normalizeForComparison` (trim, collapse whitespace runs to a single space, lowercase), throwing the new exception on a match.

2. **`DuplicateOwnerHouseholdException.java`** (new) — A `RuntimeException` carrying the offending `lastName` and `address`, mirroring `DuplicateOwnerTelephoneException`.

3. **`ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`** — Added an `@ExceptionHandler` that maps the new exception to a **409 Conflict** whose `errors` array names `lastName` and `address`.

4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — Added `rejectDuplicateHousehold(...)` into the `addOwner` pipeline. It:
   - Skips the check when `sharesHousehold` is `true`.
   - Compares the incoming `lastName` **and** `address` against every existing owner using `normalizeForComparison` (trim, collapse whitespace runs to a single space, lowercase), throwing the new exception on a match.

**Tests:** All 3 acceptance tests pass (`coreRejectsSameLastNameAndAddress` → 409; `functionalityAllowsDifferentAddress` → 2xx; `functionalityAllowsWithSharesHousehold` → 2xx), and the full `./mvnw test` build is green.
